$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (execution-trace-observability). Declares the execution_trace schema backing the per-execution step timeline joined by traceId (rule -> mapping -> synchronization -> outbound call). See openspec/changes/execution-trace-observability/design.md Decision 2 and specs/execution-trace/spec.md REQ-004/REQ-009. Follows the hitl-approval-rule-action.json fragment shape exactly.

execution_trace.title: Execution Trace
execution_trace.summary: An ordered per-execution step timeline joining rule -> mapping -> synchronization -> outbound-call activity under one traceId
execution_trace.description: Persists exactly one execution_trace object per logical execution (endpoint call, job run, event delivery, manual synchronization run). See openspec/specs/execution-trace/spec.md.

uuid.description: Canonical UUID assigned by OpenRegister (equals traceId — the client-minted id is used as the object's own id at save time)
uuid.title: UUID

traceId.description: Client-minted UUIDv4 (design.md Decision 1), used as this object's own id — no separate correlation column needed
traceId.title: Trace ID

entryPoint.description: Which of the four execution entry points minted this trace
entryPoint.title: Entry Point

entryPointId.description: uuid of the endpoint/job/subscription/synchronization that started the execution
entryPointId.title: Entry Point ID

status.description: Execution status; set to a terminal value on persist
status.title: Status

finishedAt.description: Timestamp the execution completed (success, short-circuit, or exception)
finishedAt.title: Finished At

steps.description: Ordered step timeline: {order, type, name, timing, status, durationMs, startedAt, input, output}. type in rule|mapping|synchronization|call. input/output are SensitiveFieldRegistry::redactArray()-passed snapshots (design.md Decision 3).
steps.title: Steps

error.description: Nullable terminal error {message, ruleType, ruleName}, mirroring the existing rule-pipeline HTTP 500 body shape
error.title: Error

replayOf.description: FK to the original trace this one replays; set only on a trace created by replay
replayOf.title: Replay Of

isReplay.description: True when this trace was created by a replay (dry-run or forced)
isReplay.title: Is Replay

dryRun.description: True for a dry-run preview replay (no writes performed)
dryRun.title: Dry Run

expires.description: Computed retention horizon — when this trace becomes eligible for archival
expires.title: Expires At

rules.reason: Successful non-replay traces have lower forensic value once verified — shorter than call_log's error retention (design.md Decision 2).
Dry-run preview traces are throwaway debugging artifacts.
